title: Cochain realization and H-zero normalization of a resolution pairing
statement: Let X be a scheme, and choose the sheaf derived category with Hom types in the universe of X. Let F,G be O_X-module sheaves and D a computing tensor resolution pairing [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data]. Extend its three nonnegative complexes to integer degrees by zero. A realization t is a cochain morphism from the signed total tensor of the two input complexes to the target which, on every tensor summand in nonnegative bidegrees p,q and every open V, sends the tensor of sections a,b to D.pair p q V a b, through the extension identifications. Such a t exists. Transport its localized map through the localized augmentations and precompose with the lax monoidal tensor comparison of Q; this is the explicitly defined D.derivedMap t from F[0] tensor-derived G[0] to (F tensor G)[0]. Its H-zero map equals the H-zero map of the canonical derived-to-ordinary tensor comparison [lem-sc-module-cup-canonical-hzero-identification]. This statement does not compare two pairings or cohomology classes.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, section-cup-product: construction before Lemma 20.31.3 and its global specialization

proof.text: Choose a realizing cochain morphism by the existence theorem. The cochain augmentation compatibility theorem identifies the composite of the tensor of input augmentations with this morphism.

Naturality of the lax monoidal comparison rewrites the derived composite as Q of the cochain augmentation composite. Apply the cochain equality and cancel Q of the target augmentation with its inverse. This proves equality of the derived maps themselves; applying H-zero gives the requested equality.

proof_origin.place: cochain augmentation compatibility and lax monoidal naturality; no flat-model H-zero calculation needed

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_resolution_realization {F G : X.Modules} (D : CupResolutionPairing F G) :
    let F₀ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F
    let G₀ := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G
    let canonical := Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q F₀ G₀ ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (DerivedCategory.moduleCup_singleTensorIso
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) F G).hom
    ∃ t : D.left.integerComplex ⊗ D.right.integerComplex ⟶ D.target.integerComplex,
      D.Realizes t ∧
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).map (D.derivedMap t) =
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).map canonical
